notes: Source: manufacturer spec table at tascam.com/us/product/dr-680mkii/spec (fetched via WebFetch; WebSearch was unavailable due to session budget exhaustion, so cross-verification against a retailer spec table like B&H/Sweetwater could not be completed — both returned HTTP 403 when fetched directly). All port counts/labels come directly from Tascam's official "Analog Audio Inputs / Outputs / Digital I/O / SYNC I/O / USB / Power" spec rows. Ch1-4 are combo XLR-3-31 (pin1 GND, pin2 HOT, pin3 COLD) / 1/4" TRS jacks with switchable mic (+48V phantom, 63dB gain) or line operation; Ch5-6 are TRS-only line/mic inputs. Line outs are 6x unbalanced RCA (one per channel). Digital I/O and Sync I/O are each a single RCA jack whose direction (in vs out) is set via menu, so both are modeled as bidirectional; no bandwidth grade applies since RCA/S-PDIF/AES3 digital audio is outside the graded connector list. USB is physically USB Mini-B (not present in the allowed connector-id list); mapped to the closest id "usb-micro" — flag if a more precise "usb-mini" id is ever added. Power: the DC input jack type/voltage/polarity was not stated on the spec page; mapped to "dc-barrel" as the closest listed option for an external-AC-adapter-fed unit; unit also runs on 8xAA batteries (not modeled as a port). Not rack-mountable out of the box (portable handheld/desktop field recorder), so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: Digital I/O
ports.note: Single RCA jack carries S/PDIF (IEC60958-3) or AES/EBU (AES3-2003), function as input or output is set in menu

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Physical connector is USB Mini-B (5-pin), which is not in the provided connector id list; usb-micro chosen as closest available id. Confirmed USB 2.0 High Speed (480Mbps).

ports.name: DC In (AC Adapter)
ports.note: Unit ships with an AC adapter (rated AC100-240V 50/60Hz input) plus an 8xAA battery compartment; the spec table does not state the DC barrel jack's voltage/polarity, so exact pin spec is unconfirmed.
